item.title: Taskforce Participant Perspectives | Kyle Demes from OurResearch
item.description: ‘A model where universities divert the resources they spend on curating proprietary databases to an open infrastructure who curates the metadata openly for all downstream providers to use (including the proprietary systems!) is particularly exciting.’
